trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full-context read of prop:branching-identity-isospin-weights. Re-derived EVERY claim from first principles with sympy and confirmed all of them exactly: chi(1) = (1,2,1) and chi(sigma) = (q, q-1/q, -1/q) are the correct H_3 character values; the combination -tr(sigma) - q^-1 tr(1) does cancel y_(1^3) and yields z + q^-1 = (q+q^-1)(y_(3)+y_(2,1)); tr(sigma) - q tr(1) cancels y_(3) and yields q - z = (q+q^-1)(y_(2,1)+y_(1^3)); mu_+ + mu_- = 1 identically with z cancelling, exactly as the 'vacuous' corollary says. Solving the three Markov conditions (tr(1)=1, tr(sigma)=z, tr(sigma_1 sigma_2)=z^2 with chi^{(2,1)}(sigma_1 sigma_2) = -1) at convention D z = q^3/(q^2+1) gives y_(1^3) = 0 exactly, y_(2,1) = q^2/(q^2+1)^2 = 1/[2]_q^2 exactly, so mu_- = y_(2,1) as claimed and the three 'descriptions' are literally the same rational function. The 20-digit 0.24729788674803459841 back-solves to q0 = 1.10997858275138080751, i.e. the high-precision PROTON pin (the compute default) carried beyond its 17-digit float64 literal - not muon (which gives 0.24729788615) and not 1.1097 (0.24731078).
trap-negation-contrast.notes: Two instances, both substantive: 'not new data attached to H_3(q) but the weights of the two-strand algebra seen one level up' IS the section's claim (its heading says exactly that), and 'No convention is chosen, no value of q is fixed, and no fit enters' is a scope statement about the identity's generality, each denial distinct and load-bearing in this corpus.
